title: HandyCommands
description: A small and lightweight plugin that aims to add some very useful features.
body:
# HandyCommands

## Useful

A simple and lightweight plugin that aims to add more useful commands to the game.
It adds four essential commands like: "heal", "feed", "stopfire", "kill".

## Lightweight

A very recommended plugin for a server with low resources.

## Free for Everyone!

There's no fee, to make use of the plugin!
